article.title: Prime Intellect raises $130M Series A to help enterprises build their own AI agents
article.summary: Founded in 2024, Prime Intellect’s goal is to give organizations capabilities to train their own agentic systems without relying on frontier AI labs.
article.title_zh: Prime Intellect 募資 1.3 億美元 Series A，幫助企業構建自有 AI 代理
article.summary_zh: 成立於 2024 年的 Prime Intellect 旨在使企業能夠在不依賴頂級 AI 實驗室的情況下訓練自有代理系統。

article.title: AI Chip Startup SambaNova Raises Funds at $11 Billion Value
article.summary: Chip startup SambaNova Systems Inc. has raised $1 billion at an $11 billion valuation, underscoring investors’ conviction in rising demand for infrastructure tied to artificial intelligence.
article.title_zh: AI 晶片新創公司 SambaNova 以 110 億美元估值融資
article.summary_zh: 晶片新創公司 SambaNova Systems Inc. 以 110 億美元估值融資 10 億美元，反映投資者對人工智慧基礎設施需求增長的信心。

article.title: Google Photos is finally getting its bottom bar redesign on Android
article.summary: TL;DR The Google Photos app on Android is being updated with a new navigation button layout. The new bottom bar is visually smaller and persistent across different views in the Photos app. This version has been available on iOS since early 2026, but is new for Android users. Early this year, Google rolled out a nice little UI tweak for Google Photos . The app’s bottom navigation bar was redesigned in a February update, making it more compact and allowing more of your photos to show through. At the time, that update only hit the iOS version of Photos — but now, it’s rolling out broadly on Android, too. The redesigned bottom bar is now available for many users on Android, as spotted by 9to5Google . We’re seeing it on our own phones here at Android Authority, too.
article.title_zh: Google Photos 終於在 Android 上推出底部導航欄重新設計
article.summary_zh: Google Photos Android 應用程式更新了新的導航按鈕配置，新的底部欄視覺上更小且在應用程式的各個視圖中持續顯示。此版本已在 iOS 上推出，現已登陸 Android 用戶。

article.title: This major Android brand could be working on a pocket gimbal camera with a Snapdragon 8-series chip
article.summary: TL;DR According to a leak, Xiaomi is working on a pocket gimbal camera like the DJI Osmo Pocket 4. It could use a 3nm Snapdragon 8-series chip and a large sensor main camera. The pocket camera could also be integrated with the Xiaomi ecosystem. Pocket vlogging cameras like the DJI Osmo Pocket 4P and the Insta360 Luna Ultra have become surprisingly popular, so much so that we’ve seen companies fight over who copied whom in bringing their cameras to market. However, there could soon be a new contender in the market: Xiaomi. Leaker Digital Chat Station has said in a new Weibo post that Xiaomi is working on a pocket gimbal camera and has also mentioned a couple of things about the device.
article.title_zh: 這個主要安卓品牌可能在開發配備驍龍 8 系芯片的口袋三軸雲台攝像機
article.summary_zh: 洩露信息表明 Xiaomi 正開發類似 DJI Osmo Pocket 4 的口袋三軸雲台攝像機，可能搭載 3nm 驍龍 8 系芯片和大感光器主攝像頭。

article.title: “Nature is the most computationally efficient system we know”: How Refiant used swarm optimization to build a 10-million-token AI model
article.summary: While the household-name frontier models race forward with version numbers and context windows of at least a million tokens, a new breed of upstart data science specialists is pushing the context window into double figures.  Subquadratic debuted a 12-million-token window in May of this year, and Silicon Valley and South Africa-based Refiant launched its 10-million-token context-window model, Protea, on Wednesday. It’s a move that may signal the long-context AI race is now on. Model inefficiency & workarounds are commonplace But more context windows alone are not enough. This is because even the most capable models have a few hundred thousand tokens in working memory, which can force workarounds to compensate for what the model can’t access. Refiant co-founder Dr. Viros
article.title_zh: 「大自然是我們所知最高效的計算系統」：Refiant 如何利用群體優化構建 1000 萬 token AI 模型
article.summary_zh: 當主流前沿模型競相推出更大的上下文窗口時，新興數據科學公司正在突破極限，Subquadratic 今年 5 月發布了 1200 萬 token 的窗口規模。

article.title: Crypto-Focused VC Firm Paradigm Raises $1.2 Billion for AI Bets
article.summary: Paradigm, the venture firm founded to invest in cryptocurrency companies, has raised a new $1.2 billion fund to make more bets outside of the sector, including artificial intelligence and robotics.
article.title_zh: 加密貨幣投資公司 Paradigm 為 AI 押注融資 12 億美元
article.summary_zh: 為投資加密貨幣公司而創立的創投公司 Paradigm 募集 12 億美元新基金，用於在加密貨幣之外進行更多投資，包括人工智慧和機器人。

article.title: OpenAI to Roll Out Top AI Model Globally After Limited Preview
article.summary: OpenAI is set to release its most advanced model widely on Thursday and is expanding its preview globally, the company said.
article.title_zh: OpenAI 將在全球推出頂級 AI 模型，結束有限預覽
article.summary_zh: OpenAI 計畫於週四全球廣泛發布其最先進模型，並擴大預覽範圍至全球。

article.title: Temasek Assets Break $400 Billion as AI Bets Boost Returns
article.summary: Singaporean state-owned investor Temasek Holdings Pte is ramping up its exposure to artificial intelligence and the Americas, a shift which helped push its net portfolio value to S$518 billion ($401 billion) in the last financial year.
article.title_zh: 淡馬錫資產突破 400 億美元，AI 投資提升回報
article.summary_zh: 新加坡國營投資者淡馬錫控股公司正在加大人工智慧和美洲投資力度，該策略調整有助於將其淨投資組合價值提升至 518 億新加坡元（4010 億美元）。

article.title: Meta just launched a new AI generator, Muse Image, and users are already pushing back over use of their photos
article.summary: The new image-generating model has numerous use cases, including advertising and decorating, and creator-based opportunities.

article.summary_zh: 這個新圖像生成模型具有多種用途，包括廣告和裝飾，以及基於創作者的機會。
